node.statement: Parameterized polar-retraction transport: there exist C_pol^0 >= 1 and kappa_pol^0 in (0, 1/2] such that, for every def-stage1-polar-witness-data tuple W with C_pol >= C_pol^0 and 0 < kappa_pol <= kappa_pol^0, for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra and every delta > 0 with C_pol*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_pol, the map Pi_delta: calU x B^{calH}_delta(J) -> calX, Pi_delta(U, H) = U bold-dot H, is a C^1 diffeomorphism onto the open set S_delta := Pi_delta(calU x B^{calH}_delta(J)), its inverse (u_delta, h_delta): S_delta -> calU x B^{calH}_delta(J) satisfies X = u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X), u_delta(U) = U, and h_delta(U) = J for every X in S_delta and U in calU, and calU_{delta - C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta + delta^2)} subseteq S_delta subseteq calU_{delta + C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta + delta^2)}.
node.author: orchestrator
